title: I've been working on a browser games with Claude around my 9–5. Here's my latest: a cosy idle game where you run a graveyard as the Grim Reaper
author: real-pies-realpies
selftext:
I work a 9–5, so evenings are for building small browser games with Claude. This one's Reaper's Graveyard Shift, a little idle/management game inspired by Burger Please and My Perfect Hotel, except you're the Grim Reaper. Ghosts rise from graves, you check them in, hire skeleton workers, unlock helpers and expand the graveyard.

A few things I learned making it:

 \- Everything's drawn in code, no image files or models. Claude was surprisingly good at the chunky low-poly look once I showed it a few games I liked

 \- Getting it working was quick. Getting it to feel nice took ages. I went back and forth on the stacking and how fast the souls pay out loads of times

\- AI has no idea when something's fun. I had to play it a lot and explain exactly what felt off

\- Someone on Reddit already asked for a save system, so that's next

It's free in the browser: https://playgama.ai/play/dy2amecok7

Happy to answer anything about how I made it. And if you give it a go, I'd love to know where you got bored or confused
